look.why: A calm mangrove-leaf green that frames the dark olive armor and pale ivory teeth without muddy contrast.

size.measure: total length 4.3–5.2 m in adult males, up to 6+ m (largest living reptile)

habitat.text: Brackish estuaries, mangrove swamps, coastal rivers, and open seas from eastern India through Southeast Asia to northern Australia.

diet.text: Fish, crabs, turtles, birds, wild boars, and large mammals ambushed at the water's edge.

facts.text: Delivers the strongest measured bite force of any living animal, exceeding 16,000 newtons.
Special salt glands on its tongue excrete excess salt, allowing it to travel hundreds of kilometres across open ocean.

id.habitat: Muara payau, hutan bakau, sungai pesisir, dan laut lepas dari India timur, Asia Tenggara, hingga Australia utara.
id.diet: Ikan, kepiting, penyu, burung, babi hutan, dan mamalia besar yang disergap di tepi air.
facts: Memiliki kekuatan gigitan terkuat di antara semua hewan yang hidup saat ini, melampaui 16.000 newton.
Kelenjar garam khusus di lidahnya membuang kelebihan garam sehingga mampu berenang ratusan kilometer di laut lepas.
